title: Sea Friends Song with Pip, Lulu, and Bo
yt_description:
Join Pip, Lulu, and Bo as they explore fun sea animals! This gentle song teaches toddlers to recognize simple sea creatures and their sounds, encouraging early learning and joyful singing.

🎵 Sea Friends Song with Pip, Lulu, and Bo

Hello friends, let's sing today
Meet the sea animals, hooray!

Fish swim fast, swish swish swish
Crabs walk sideways, click and click

Swim with friends beneath the sea
Pip, Lulu, Bo, and me!

Sea stars sparkle, bright and round
Dolphins jump up, make a sound!

Sea animals say goodbye
Sing with us till next time, bye!

Pip & Friends
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.

#Shorts #KidsSongs #seaanimals #toddlersong #kidsmusic
